wsl.priorBlockedAttempt: A previous WSL attempt reported HCS_E_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE; Ubuntu subsequently started after the user’s environment update.

issues.title: Windows ARM64 native-codegen tests selected the x64 Zig package
issues.fix: Select Zig package using current OS and architecture; added six-target mapping regression cases.

issues.title: Standalone packaging labels were hard-coded to x64
issues.rootCause: The package script used x64 labels for Windows, Linux, and macOS regardless of host architecture.
issues.fix: Added a validated host target resolver for OS/architecture and platform-specific executable names.
issues.verification: Six target mappings plus unsupported architecture rejection pass in Jest; full package generation was not rerun to avoid overwriting existing release evidence.

issues.title: Release workflow covered only three platform/architecture combinations and CI results were not archived as machine-readable artifacts
issues.rootCause: Workflow matrices and outcome evidence were incomplete.
issues.fix: Configured six release host/target pairs, archived per-run CI outcomes, and preserved container valid/invalid runtime output.
issues.verification: YAML parsing and target triple parsing passed locally; no hosted run was triggered.

issues.title: Container build and execution are uncertified
issues.rootCause: Docker and Podman are unavailable and WSL2 cannot start on this host.
issues.fix: Container workflow records build/runtime outcomes and uploads valid/invalid logs; actual image test remains outstanding.

issues.title: Four required platform architectures lack execution evidence
issues.rootCause: No matching Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64, or macOS x64/ARM64 executions were available. Linux x64 did execute but failed required tests.
issues.fix: Configured six-platform CI and release matrices; actual hosted execution remains outstanding.
issues.verification: BLOCKED for four targets; Linux x64 FAIL.

issues.title: First draft of the new Jest table had a readonly tuple type error
issues.rootCause: An as-const table did not match Jest’s mutable callback tuple typing.
issues.fix: Declared a typed mutable tuple array.

issues.title: Dependency installation reported one high and six moderate advisories
issues.rootCause: npm ci audit summary for the locked dependency graph; advisory identities were not separately queried.
issues.fix: No dependency changes or automatic npm audit fixes were applied during certification.
issues.verification: npm ci completed with exit code 0 and reported 7 vulnerabilities (6 moderate, 1 high).

linuxLocalInvestigation.scope: Genuine Ubuntu WSL2 Linux x64 execution against a separate Linux-native copy of the current Windows working tree.

environment.uname: Linux DESKTOP-SMU3KLA 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Oct 27 00:24:11 UTC 2026 x86_64 GNU/Linux

nodeInstall.method: official Node 22 Linux x64 tarball extracted under Ubuntu home; no sudo/system install

coverage: symlink-based package extraction rejection and out-of-destination write prevention

zig.failure: zig test src/main.zig fails compiling src/jit/x86_64.zig: mmap protection values use integer constants where Zig 0.16 expects a PROT struct; std.posix.mprotect is also unavailable as called.
zig.diagnosticTrial: A PROT struct-only experiment in the Linux copy exposed the subsequent unused integer constants and missing std.posix.mprotect API. It was reverted; the Linux copy file was restored byte-for-byte from the Windows source and cmp returned 0.

invalidProgram.diagnostic: HKD Error[E202]: Expected variable name, found =

runtimeAndCli.nativeVmMode: PASS during post-build test recheck; the five differential failures are standalone executable invocations.

standaloneParity.diagnostic: USAGE: hkd-runtime [options] <file.hkdb>; generated standalone executable did not execute embedded bytecode without an argument.

deploymentFuzzing.rootCause: verifyArtifact calls readFileSync/computeSha256 without converting unreadable-file errors into an invalid VerificationResult.

container.reason: Neither docker nor podman executable is installed in Ubuntu; no image build/runtime test was attempted.

failures.rootCause: Zig 0.16 Linux mmap/mprotect API incompatibility in src/jit/x86_64.zig.
Generated standalone programs exit 2 with runtime usage text instead of executing embedded bytecode; native VM mode passed after runtime build.
Release verifier detects the same Linux standalone native bundle failure.
Unreadable /etc/shadow read error escapes verifyArtifact instead of returning invalid.

linuxLocalInvestigation.conclusion: Linux x64 execution was genuine. Some builds/runtime checks pass, but overall Linux certification FAILS because Zig test compilation and standalone executable/release verification fail. Container remains BLOCKED.
